news.title: 针对智能体运行框架训练适配器
news.body: 作者介绍在特定任务分布和运行框架内，用强化学习训练 LoRA 适配器，以改善模型表现及令牌效率。结果来自所测模型、任务和框架，不能推广为所有工作负载均能降本提效。
news.title_original: Introducing harness adapters: adapt your favorite model to your harness to improve performance and cost

news.title: 用量子关联挑战经典策略的游戏
news.body: Google 介绍在超导处理器上测试量子情境性的方法，以受约束的协作游戏解释经典与量子策略差异。理想策略的优势不意味着实际硬件无噪声，也不是对所有计算任务的加速证明。
news.title_original: A game you cannot win unless you have a quantum computer

news.title: AI 辅助分析医学研究如何共享代码
news.body: MIT 等机构研究临床预测研究中的代码共享方式，强调公开代码还需清晰结构与说明才能支持理解和复用。报道是科研可复现性研究，不提供临床治疗结论。
news.title_original: AI helps researchers investigate how thousands of medical studies share code
news.body_original: An MIT and Dana-Farber Institute-led team used large language models to examine nearly 4,000 studies and hundreds of code repositories, revealing gaps in the information needed to scrutinize and reuse published research.

news.title: 研究模拟数据中心用电对远方空气质量的影响
news.body: MIT 研究将电网调度与大气污染模型相结合，估算数据中心用电可能影响远离设施所在地的空气质量和健康。影响量来自模型估计，不能当作逐例观测的因果归属。
news.title_original: Study reveals data centers’ long-distance damage to air quality
news.body_original: Researchers find air pollution from data center electricity use can affect communities far from the facilities, with some of the highest impacts in the Midwest.

news.body: RadixArk 发布基于 Qwen 的模型，报告用精选长程智能体任务进行强化学习后训练，并在终端任务等基准中取得改进。成绩属于发布方评测；长训练会话不等同于模型原生上下文长度同步扩大。

news.title: 为什么微调耗时会超过 FLOP 估算
news.body: 作者分析共享 GPU 集群中的实际监督微调任务，讨论仅按浮点运算量估计端到端耗时的局限。该文章为后续论文预览，结论受生产任务样本和硬件环境限制。

news.title: 将时间序列模型接入实时数据流
news.body: IBM 与 Confluent 介绍将时间序列预测、异常检测等能力接入流式数据处理，让输出更接近实时业务流程。服务集成不保证预测准确，也不能替代业务场景验证。

news.title: 自带传感器和计算单元的轻型飞行机器人
news.body: MIT 展示携带传感器和计算单元的扑翼微型机器人，可脱离实验室运动捕捉系统进行导航。机器人仍连接外部电源，不能描述为完全无线自主飞行。

news.body_original: The speedy microrobot flies without an attached motion-capture system, moving it closer to applications like agriculture or industrial surveillance.

papers.body: arXiv:2611.25127v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Search for optimal compositions among high-entropy ceramics are challenging due to large composition space, which are unable to test either experimentally or by \textit{ab initio} calculations. Here we present a high-throughput screening for equimolar and non-equimolar high-entropy carbides (HEC) among group IVB and VB transition metals (Ti, Zr, Hf, V, Nb and Ta). Large Atomistic Model MACE, and deep learning based interatomic potential DeePMD trained on \textit{ab initio}-based dataset of structures are used to effectively screen over the thousands of potential non-equimolar compositions among high-entropy carbides of Ti, Zr, Hf, V, Nb and Ta

papers.body: arXiv:2611.26186v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reward misalignment is usually regarded as a failure of artificial intelligence. We investigate this possibility using electronic flat bands as a prime example. papers.title: Perfumer：智能体连接结构预弛豫与能带预测
papers.body: arXiv:2611.26349v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: First-principles structural relaxation and band calculations require substantial computation and expertise. Here we present Perfumer, a large language model-based agentic framework that couples Quantum ESPRESSO with two predictive models. Across tested structures, pre-relaxation with Perfumer-relax model followed by QE refinement yielded a 2.75-fold overall speedup over QE alone. Perfumer-band model combines a periodic graph neural network with a latent Hermitian spectral head returns 12 band energies at any requested wavevector, preserving reciprocal lattice periodicity and time-reversal symmetry without constructing Hamiltonian. papers.title: 从非均匀实验识别可解释的超弹性应变能
papers.body: arXiv:2611.26528v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Calibrating a hyperelastic constitutive model for a soft material traditionally poses two problems: an expert must choose its functional form, and several homogeneous tests must determine its parameters. Neural constitutive models solve the first, but either remain black boxes or draw on a library of candidate terms fixed in advance. Full-field measurements, such as those from digital image correlation (DIC), promise to solve the second, replacing those tests by a single heterogeneous one. Two gaps remain: flexibility during training with interpretability afterwards, and a way to train such a model on one heterogeneous test. Here we close both.

In this work, we show that even a vanilla crystal VAE implicitly organizes atom-wise latent representations according to elemental families, with different families occupying largely separated regions of the latent space.
